searchText: So I created this library and app that can disintermediate JSON-RPC services. How do I find projects and users that are interested in using such a library? So far I have made it work with freedom-browser (ENS) and Swarm. The EF mandate specifically mentions RPC services as a choke point. But nobody in the EF showed an interest in my project. (Except Kohaku. But they have been dissolved in the meantime 🙁 ) Is that part of the EF mandate only a lip service?

excerpts.author: dirkjaeckel
excerpts.content:
So I created this library and app that can disintermediate JSON-RPC services. How do I find projects and users that are interested in using such a library? So far I have made it work with freedom-browser (ENS) and Swarm. 

The EF mandate specifically mentions RPC services as a choke point. But nobody in the EF showed an interest in my project. (Except Kohaku. But they have been dissolved in the meantime 🙁 )

Is that part of the EF mandate only a lip service?
